<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Map-first packet production, direct work-packet delivery, one nonmutating advisory self-check, and import consumers detached from the retired acknowledgement handshake. Detailed role/slice contracts are in the implementation guide; no later on-track or coder-map warning completion is implied.
